name: Jaconelli
fit_note: Dark havana with grey-gradient lenses is the most versatile of the five Jaconelli colours, works with navy, chocolate and his winter look, and is clearly different from his lilac crystal pair (the amber is a loud mustard yellow and the crystal-green and clear versions repeat what he already has); it comes in one size, which works out at about 142 mm across, the same as his reference pair.

name: Wayne Sun 49
fit_note: Havana is the only warm frame in this model, and its polarised blue lenses (a tint, not a mirror) pick up his navy and light-blue pieces, while the other options are black, clear grey and pink crystal; it costs €30 more than the non-polarised colours, and the single 49 size (49-21-148) is 144 mm across, just 2 mm over his reference.

name: Lemtosh Sun 49
fit_note: Classic tortoise with G-15 green lenses is the timeless old-money Lemtosh that goes with everything from cream linen to navy and sage, and size 49 (144 mm front according to Moscot) is the closest to his 142 mm, while the 46 (139 mm) would look small on a medium-to-large head; only one pair is left at this shop.

name: Filipe (Medium)
fit_note: Olive (Jurassic) with brown lenses adds an earthy Copenhagen colour that suits his sage, khaki and brown-suede outfits and stands apart from all the tortoise options and his lilac crystal pair (the other colours are smoky grey, black, and a honey horn called Smooth Jazz, which is the runner-up); Filipe only comes in Medium (49-21-150), which is 140 mm across, 2 mm under his reference.

name: Elpatio (Cedar)
fit_note: Cedar's honey tortoise with dark green lenses is the warmest classic among the 20-plus Elpatio colours (most of the others are two-tone or bright) and suits cream, khaki, sage and brown suede; it comes in one size (47-18-145), and measuring the official product photo puts it at about 140 mm across, close to his reference (the usual formula would give only about 132 mm).
